name: Septem
source:
The Magician of September / The Historian Magician

The librarian in charge of the histories of all the worlds, he's a diligent and earnest young man. His job as the September Magician is to be a historian for the entire world, recording people's lives after death. Excluding his mentor, Septem lives alone in his world, constantly interviewing spirits about their lives, and writing records/books from that. Sturdy branches and blue flowers grow out of his back, which he can move at will.

He tries his best to be professional, but his curiosity and hidden desire to make friends usually gets the best of him. He'll often end up smiling shyly and awkwardly during a conversation due to his lack of experience. He does seem to have a grim and calculating side to him, unbeknownst to even himself. It's up to Iris to make sure he stays on the right path. 

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/814614.septem]official bio[/url]]
